messages:
Sam (sales): Quick kickoff — EdgeSweep wants a short POC. Requirements: streaming SSE, function/tool calls to their extractor service, structured JSON output, SAML SSO + delegated creds. Can we commit to an SDK sample + handshake doc? Also need pricing for ~100k tokens/day and a Dedicated reserved option.
Anya (eng): Hi Sam — we can do a sample adapter + handshake guide. ETA ~5 business days for a minimal Node + Go client + README. Do they need bi-directional websocket callbacks or SSE only? :thinking:
Sam (sales): SSE only from our side, but tool calls will be outbound HTTP webhooks from the POC adapter into their extractor. They need per-connection bearer auth on the socket.
Jordan (presales): For SSO we'll need SAML metadata + SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated preference. They'll likely want SCIM for user provisioning later. Also confirm KMS requirement — do they want us to hold keys? If no, we can support customer-managed KMS for Private.
Lee (security): They asked about SOC2 and IP allowlist. For POC we can offer ephemeral creds + IP allowlist + redact logs. Need to confirm log retention and whether cached prefixes are stored longer than session. @Anya please note caching policy.
Mike (ops): Low-latency SSE + 50ms p99 suggests Dedicated or Private. Quick back-of-envelope: hosted usage at $0.0006/token => 100k tokens/day ≈ $60/day. Dedicated baseline (reserved) estimate: ~$5k–7k/mo depending on instance sizes. I'll prepare a detailed cost table.
Anya (eng): Example SDK snippet for streaming + tool call handshake:
```
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, url: 'https://edge.redwood.example' });
const s = client.stream({ model: 'rw-instruct-v1', streaming: true });
s.on('data', (chunk) => console.log('token', chunk));
// For tool-calls we sign outbound webhooks with header 'X-RW-Signature'
```
We support per-connection headers (Authorization: Bearer <token>) and ephemeral tokens via our token-manager for short-lived sockets.
Jordan (presales): I'll draft the SOW + a runbook with steps: 1) SAML metadata exchange, 2) IP allowlist + firewall contacts, 3) webhook endpoint test, 4) pricing sign-off. Sam — can you get the customer's SAML XML and ops contact?
Sam (sales): On it. I'll DM the contact details. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
